summary: Static-site tool pack: asset-stamp.py appends each asset's own content hash to the URL the HTML emits, so a CDN edge holding an immutable copy is forced to fetch the new bytes while unchanged assets keep their URL and stay cached — and in --check mode it fails a build whose pages still point at a stale or unstamped asset. Derived from a measured incident where an edge served a three-day-old file with cf-cache-status HIT for hours after a green deploy, because nothing in the pipeline looks at what the edge actually serves.
